from.description: Sender name or email address filter to return only messages from that sender

to.description: Recipient name or email address filter to return only messages that contain the recipient in the recipient list

folder.description: Folder name filter, only return the mail in the selected directory. create_time.description: 模板创建时间（毫秒级时间戳字符串）

update.description: 以全量替换的方式更新指定邮件模板的所有字段（包括名称、主题、正文、附件、收件信息等）。本接口为「全量更新」语义：请求时需传入完整的模板对象，未携带的字段将被清空。调用依赖：如仅修改部分字段，请先调用获取个人邮件模板详情接口拿到完整模板，在本地修改后再传回本接口，以避免漏传字段导致数据丢失

user_mailbox_id.description: 用户邮箱地址，作为用户邮箱身份标识。使用 user_access_token 调用时，可使用占位符 `me` 表示当前授权用户的主邮箱

template_id.description: 邮件模板 ID。可通过列出个人邮件模板接口或创建个人邮件模板接口的返回值获取

template.description: 替换后的完整模板内容（全量替换）

name.description: 模板名称，不超过 100 字符

subject.description: 邮件主题，不超过 1000 字符

template_content.description: 模板正文（HTML 或纯文本）。单模板正文大小上限 3 MB（3 \* 1024 \* 1024 字节），超过将返回错误码 1230006 template content size limit exceeded

is_plain_text_mode.description: 是否为纯文本模式。`true` 表示模板正文按纯文本渲染，`false` 表示按 HTML 渲染。默认 `false`（HTML 模式）

attachments.description: 模板附件与内嵌图片列表

id.description: 附件 id（Drive file_key，用于引用 Drive medias 上传接口返回的 file_key）

is_inline.description: 是否为内联图片，true 表示是内联图片

cid.description: 内容 ID，HTML 中通过 cid: 协议引用该图片

add_label_ids.description: Label to be added. Optional values include: UNREAD, IMPORTANT, OTHER, FLAGGED, and custom label ID

remove_label_ids.description: Label to be removed. Optional values include: UNREAD, IMPORTANT, OTHER, FLAGGED, and custom label ID

add_folder.description: Folder to be moved into. Supports INBOX, SENT, SPAM, ARCHIVED and custom folder IDs

thread_ids.description: The mail thread ID for the action, which can be obtained by listing the mail threads

format.description: Specifies the returned mail content format. Supported values: full, plain_text_full, and metadata. Default: full, which returns complete content such as labels, folders, subject, sender, HTML body, and plain text body

include_spam_trash.description: Whether to include messages from the spam folder (SPAM) and trash folder (TRASH). true means include them; false means exclude them. Default: false

body_preview.description: A summary of the latest email within the thread for a quick preview of the core content of the email
The first 100 characters of the plain text content of the email body, based on base64url encoding, are used to quickly preview the core content of the email without decoding the full body
